summaries.class_summary: HPXPrinterDetails is a UI page class for Android Smart app that handles printer details screen interactions including camera scan, print photos, shortcuts, scan, print documents, copy, mobile fax, printables, print quality tools, product information, and printer information features.

methods.description: It Swipes to find the camera scan tile and clicks on it.

method_input_parameters.name: timeout
method_input_parameters.parameter_purpose: Maximum time to wait for the camera scan tile element

method_input_parameters.name: raise_e
method_input_parameters.parameter_purpose: Flag to determine whether to raise exception if element not found

method_input_parameters.name: max_swipes
method_input_parameters.parameter_purpose: Maximum number of swipes to perform while searching for the element

methods.method_output_parameter: Boolean True if camera scan tile is found and clicked, raises Exception otherwise
methods.method_purpose: Locates and clicks the camera scan tile by swiping through the screen up to max_swipes times
